sup:70740.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

sup:70740.subject: part:370010 – proposal for the coming contract period
sup:70740.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation and for reviewing our requirements. We would very much like to continue working with Werdenfels and appreciate your consideration of a longer-term arrangement.

Would you kindly consider EUR 4.60/kg for part:370010, with payment within 30 days net and a 36-month contract? We propose AS-14404 on a 45% material share, with a 0% deadband and base month 2026-08. Our requirement is 23,700 kg/year, DAP, with a 14-day lead time, effective from 2027-01-01 and no tooling charges.

Our purchase orders with you for part:370010 on 2 and 17 June 2026 were at EUR 5.26/kg (po:4500014022-10, po:4500014078-10), compared with EUR 5.84/kg on 1 and 18 September 2026 (po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10).

We recognise the cost pressures you described and hope that the longer commitment and proposed adjustment mechanism give us a useful basis for reviewing the starting price together. A 24-month commitment would also be possible if that suits your team better.

Could you kindly let us know what binding offer you can approve?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70740.subject: Re: part:370010 – proposal for the coming contract period
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Acknowledging the historical purchase orders you referenced, we can revise our offer to €5.40 per kg under these updated terms.

Our main offer is a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

We appreciate your interest in a long-term partnership and agree to implement the AS-14404 index mechanism to manage material volatility. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C, and we can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

As you suggested, a 24-month contract duration provides a more balanced framework for this new structure. Alternatively, with a contract term of 24 months: €5.40 per unit. This alternative package features a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

sup:70740.subject: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
sup:70740.body:
Thank you for working through the options with us. We appreciate your team's careful review and would like to find an arrangement that works for Werdenfels as well as for us.

For your review, PPI-C2431 changed by -2.27% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08). We recognise that this recent movement can coexist with the annual increase you described. Could you take it into account when reviewing the starting price?

Could you kindly consider one of these complete alternatives? Each price is conditional on its payment term and adjustment clause.

Option A: EUR 5.07/kg, payment within 30 days net, a 36-month contract, AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 5% deadband and base month 2026-08.
Option B: EUR 5.05/kg, payment within 14 days net, a 36-month contract, AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 5% deadband and base month 2026-08.
Option C: EUR 5.10/kg, payment within 60 days net, a 36-month contract, AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 5% deadband and base month 2026-08.

The fixed terms of our enquiry remain unchanged. These are new proposals for your approval. Could you issue the option you can approve as your binding offer? If none works, which term would need to change? We would be pleased to review it together.

Kind regards,
Purchasing

sup:70740.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are always delighted to work with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and support your needs with our broad range and reliable service.

We have verified the PPI-C2431 data you provided and factored the recent decrease into our calculation. Building on your Option A, we agree to the 36-month contract duration and 30 days net payment terms. Reflecting the updated index data, we can revise our offer to EUR 5.30 per kg.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Specifically, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.

Our current Angebot is a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

sup:70740.subject: Part 370010 – closing proposal on your 30-day / 36-month structure
sup:70740.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised quotation and for building on our Option A. We appreciate your move to EUR 5.30/kg with payment within 30 days net, the 36-month term and the AS-14404 clause with a 5% deadband. This brings us very close together.

For your review, AS-14404 changed by -5.49% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09). We recognise that this recent movement coexists with the annual increase you described. The proposed adjustment clause would continue to let the material share follow the index over the contract term.

On that basis, could you kindly approve EUR 5.10/kg with payment within 30 days net and a 36-month contract? We propose AS-14404 on a 45% material share, with a 5% deadband and base month 2026-08. The fixed terms of our enquiry remain unchanged: 23,700 kg/year, DAP, a 14-day lead time, effective from 2027-01-01 and no tooling charges.

If you can issue this as your binding offer, we would be very pleased to finalise it with you and continue our cooperation with Werdenfels.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

sup:70740.subject: Re: Part 370010 – closing proposal on your 30-day / 36-month structure
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. We always strive to provide you with the best service from our extensive product range. 

We have verified the AS-14404 index data you provided and factored the recent decrease into our calculation. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Specifically, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.

Building on your proposal, we can revise our offer to EUR 5.20 per kg with payment within 30 days net and a 36-month contract. This adjustment reflects a fair sharing of the recent material cost reduction while securing the long-term stability you requested.

Please note our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our offer features a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for reviewing our three options so carefully and for building on Option A. We appreciate the move to EUR 5.30/kg and your agreement to the 30-day payment and the AS-14404 clause with a 5% deadband.

We would ask you to consider one further point. AS-14404 changed by -5.49% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09). We recognise that this recent window sits alongside the annual increase you described. The clause would still adjust the price if the index moves beyond the agreed band in either direction.

With that in mind, could you review Option A once more? It is EUR 5.07/kg, payment 30 days net and a 36-month contract. It includes AS-14404 on a 45% material share with a 5% deadband and base month 2026-08. The fixed enquiry terms remain unchanged.

If you cannot approve this package, could you tell us whether the main obstacle is the starting price or the 5% deadband? That would help us understand where a solution might lie.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for accepting the 36-month term with the AS-14404 clause. We appreciate the movement your team has made.

As your offer already combines 30-day payment, a 36-month contract and AS-14404 on a 45% material share with a 5% deadband and base month 2026-08, the remaining difference appears to be the unit price. On that same structure, could you approve EUR 5.07/kg as a binding offer?

We acknowledge the annual rise in AS-14404 you mentioned. Over the more recent window, AS-14404 changed by -5.49% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09). With the clause in place, movements beyond the 5% deadband would be reflected in the price for both sides.

The fixed terms of our enquiry remain unchanged. If EUR 5.07/kg cannot be approved, could you let us know whether the price level itself or another element of the package prevents approval?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Mr Seidl,
